'''Raikhssa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who served as [[War Chief]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he negotiated with [[Bant Eerin's Padawan]] shortly before the [[Battle of Akoshissss]] in order to prevent Trandosha's militia force from partaking in the conflict.<ref name="TWotJ" />
